category_title: Adolescent students with learning disabilities who under-request accommodations and struggle with the social steps of self-advocacy
minimal_context: The student is completing a Skills Inventory Survey in a special education English class to identify their strengths and needs.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please complete this Skills Inventory Survey so we can identify your strengths and needs, and figure out what accommodations you might need.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't think I will ever need an accommodation. I've never requested one.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just go through the list of skills on the survey.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even know what an LD is or that I have this learning condition.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think should happen with your accommodations?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I expect my teachers to be responsible for my accommodations. I have little to do with them.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please complete this Skills Inventory Survey so we can identify your strengths and needs, and figure out what accommodations you might need.

STUDENT: I don't think I will ever need an accommodation. I've never requested one.

TUTOR: Let's just go through the list of skills on the survey.

STUDENT: I don't even know what an LD is or that I have this learning condition.

TUTOR: What do you think should happen with your accommodations?

STUDENT: I expect my teachers to be responsible for my accommodations. I have little to do with them.

task.content: Completing a 20-item Skills Inventory Survey and matching personal needs to specific accommodations
task.learning_goal: identifying their strengths and needs and completing the survey

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Initial perception of responsibility for academic accommodations prior to receiving self-advocacy instruction
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: expected their teachers to be responsible for their accommodations
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: unaware what an LD was or that they had this learning condition

behavior_patterns.condition: Interview regarding the need for accommodations
behavior_patterns.internal_state: did not think he would ever need an accommodation, although his teachers disagreed
